sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and a solid record of seven wins, one draw, and two losses overall. Alsager sit bottom with just four points and are in dire form, having won only once in their last five outings, making this a favorable fixture for Sandbach to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host third-placed Dawley Town on Saturday in a direct title-race clash. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third with 19 points, welcome Eccleshall (18 points) in another competitive mid-table fixture. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points and in strong recent form, travel to Wednesfield Community (13 points) in a winnable away fixture. Bilston Town (17 points) visit Foley Meir (11 points) in the Midlands; Barnton (15 points) host Shawbury United (10 points), with the visitors struggling in 15th place on a six-game losing run. Market Drayton Town face New Mills away despite being level on 12 points in the table; Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-mid-table encounter. Brereton Social (11 points) entertain Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) at home on Saturday before facing a midweek trip to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a fixture between the two lowest-scoring teams in recent form.
